The native plan binds explicit prefill/decode state, coefficient shapes and source-locked artifact roles. Generated tiny checkpoint execution passes local prefill/decode parity; protected recurrence and real-checkpoint quality remain unchecked.

Generated tiny checkpoint execution passes local prefill/decode parity; no provider-protected or real-checkpoint claim follows.

adapters.name: Dense Qwen2 (Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct)
adapters.runtime_evidence: Pinned Qwen2.5-0.5B local prefill/decode functionality test; tiny compiled two-role protocol test. The historical baseline cohort predates compiler-bound live execution
adapters.remaining: Other Qwen2 checkpoints need their own import, configuration, and quality checks; protected whole decoder absent

adapters.name: Dense Qwen3 (Qwen3-0.6B)
adapters.runtime_evidence: Pinned Qwen3-0.6B checkpoint imported and executed through 114 compiled baseline stages, prefill and decode; tiny compiled two-role protocol test and scoped clear-reference probes, no real-checkpoint provider benchmark
adapters.remaining: W4A4 fails top-token parity on two checked prompts; the local-role default W8A8 also fails one short prompt. Quantization-quality, real-checkpoint serving and matched benchmark evidence, and protected whole-decoder execution remain open

adapters.name: Bounded dense bias-free decoder (tiny Llama-style fixtures)
adapters.runtime_evidence: A pinned public Llama 3.1 8B configuration mirror lowers and compiles for a bounded 8+2 token workload without loading weights. Generated tiny bias-free checkpoints pass unscaled tied/untied parity and bounded wavelength-transition scaling: scaled W8A8 prefill/decode matches PyTorch selections with less than 0.05 worst logit error; prepared and client-only SDK/gateway requests complete
adapters.remaining: No real Llama checkpoint, tokenizer or representative quality evidence; other RoPE scaling types, sliding attention, projection bias and protected execution remain unsupported

adapters.name: Qwen3.5-4B text decoder
adapters.runtime_evidence: Pinned Qwen3.5-4B text configuration lowers to a complete native baseline schedule. A generated tiny checkpoint binds fused projection, convolution and decay artifacts and runs the client-only compiled prefill/decode decoder; selected tokens match the upstream float32 Torch reference and W8A8 logit drift stays below 0.05. A second generated-tiny test completes prepared SDK and gateway requests with two local children, masked stage traffic and zero plaintext prompt/token-ID bytes sent. The text-only partial MRoPE numeric profile independently matches Torch at checked positions
adapters.remaining: Official Qwen3.5 checkpoint import and independent reference quality, real-checkpoint provider serving, protected execution, independent providers and independent multimodal position axes remain unchecked

adapters.name: Phi-4-mini-instruct
adapters.runtime_evidence: Pinned official BF16 checkpoint imports all 194 required artifacts into 130 compiled stages and executes original-context prefill/decode locally. On the same two-prompt float32 reference cohort, W4A4 scores 0/2, W8A8 1/2 (29.90 worst logit error), and checkpoint-bound public equalized W8A8 2/2 (9.59); five other prompts score 3/5 for both W8A8 choices. A separate two-child local prepared request completes 128 masked remote stages, with zero plaintext prompt/token-ID traffic and 1.63 MB fewer covered online bodies than matched W8A8, while increasing client bundle bytes. Tiny generated weights also pass reference parity and SDK/gateway requests. Extended-context crossing fails closed
adapters.remaining: Narrow cohorts do not establish representative generation quality or full-response compute-cap compliance; two co-located children do not establish independent-provider privacy; real-checkpoint gateway, protected execution and LongRoPE context transition (KV re-rotation) remain open

adapters.name: Gemma 4 E2B text decoder
adapters.runtime_evidence: Pinned E2B: 213 checkpoint-bound compiled stages, two local-clear W8A8 prefill-to-decode runs; 2/2 same-token top-1, 0.70 mean top-5 recall and 3.5625 worst logit error against BF16; one prepared HTTP request completes through separate in-process inference and preparation services with masked online traffic
adapters.remaining: Two-child deployment, independent-provider privacy, representative generation quality and matched cost evidence

adapters.name: Gemma 4 E4B text decoder
adapters.runtime_evidence: Pinned complete compiler prefill/decode schedule and isolated BF16 tests; E2B checkpoint executes locally but E4B has no checkpoint execution
adapters.remaining: E4B checkpoint import, provider-backed prepared execution, quality and cost evidence
